'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Paul Bonsall DS Separatist Uprising''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Paul Bonsall]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Separatist Uprising / At War With Itself]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
